methods.name: Set
methods.description:
Save the organization's key for a provider.

 The key is checked once against the provider before it is saved, and a
 key the provider rejects is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT. Refused with
 FAILED_PRECONDITION, reason PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED, when the
 organization's plan does not include bring-your-own provider keys.
 Returns the saved key without its secret.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Remove the organization's key for a provider.

 Allowed on every plan, so an organization that left the plan can always
 remove what it saved. NOT_FOUND when the organization holds no key for
 the provider. Returns the removed key without its secret.

methods.name: List
methods.description:
List the keys that serve the organization, its own and any it inherits
 from its integrator, without their secrets.

methodTypes.name: SetProviderKeyInput
methodTypes.description:
Save the organization's key for a provider, replacing any key it holds for
 that provider.

fields.name: ApiKey
fields.description: The provider API key. Write-only: no read returns it.

methodTypes.name: DeleteProviderKeyInput
methodTypes.description: Remove the organization's key for a provider.

fields.name: Keys
fields.description:
One row per provider the organization is served on its own or its
 integrator's key, in provider order.

resourceDescription:
An organization's own LLM provider key, as every caller sees it: the key
 itself never leaves the server, only which provider it is for, a hint to
 tell two keys apart, and who saved it and when.

 An organization holds at most one key per provider. While its plan
 includes bring-your-own provider keys, the Stigmer Cloud proxy serves the
 organization's calls to that provider on this key: the provider bills the
 organization directly, and Stigmer meters the calls without charging them.

 Provider keys are not an API resource. They are keyed by organization and
 provider, and they authorize against the organization, as billing does.
